snapshot.reason: The proposed rights issue on a non-fully underwritten basis signals significant dilution risk and potential liquidity stress for existing shareholders.
snapshot.why_now: The announcement was filed on September 18, 2026, and the market has yet to price in the full impact of the capital dilution.
source_headlines: ZJ UNITED INV (08366): (1) PROPOSED CAPITAL REORGANISATION; (2) PROPOSED CHANGE IN BOARD LOT SIZE; (3) PROPOSED RIGHTS ISSUE ON THE BASIS OF ONE (1) RIGHTS SHARE FOR EVERY ONE (1) ADJUSTED SHARE HELD ON THE RECORD DATE ON A NON-FULLY UNDERWRITTEN BASIS; AND (4) CONNECTED TRANSACTION IN RELATION TO THE PLACING AGREEMENT AND THE UNDERWRITING AGREEMENT; AND (5) NOTICE OF EGM
